## DescriptionList.svelte

### `interface DescriptionItem`

- `term` :: The term.
- `description` :: The definition.

### `interface Props`

- `items` :: Term and definition pairs. When omitted, `children` are rendered inside the list.
- `orientation` :: `vertical` stacks the term over the definition; `horizontal` places them on one row.
- `columns` :: How many columns of pairs to lay out.
- `dividers` :: Draws a hairline between pairs.
- `textSize` :: The scale of the definitions.
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the terms.
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the terms.
- `children` :: Custom terms and definitions, used when `items` is omitted.
